title: As-Needed Consulting Services for AHA Affordable Housing
short_description: On-call consulting pool for affordable housing and public housing authority support services.
project_scope: Creation of an as-needed consultant pool for future affordable housing and public housing authority related assignments by the Housing Authority of the City of Alameda. The notice does not define a specific building, site, size, gross floor area, span, or construction program. Potential future tasks may relate to housing developments and associated planning, civil, geotechnical, environmental, cost, and project management services.
services: On-call consulting services including civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, cost estimating, housing and urban development, planning/master planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style as-needed consultant pool without a defined technical project.
- Focus is largely on housing, planning, environmental, geotechnical, and project management services.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, tower, or complex building is identified.
- Includes civil engineering, but no clear structural design scope or architecturally demanding structure.
- Explicitly resembles project types of limited interest to sbp, especially planning-only and PM-oriented services.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is for an on-call consulting pool and does not define any specific project, building size, or construction volume from which a realistic estimate could be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because this is an as-needed multi-consultant pool without defined task orders, scope, or budget, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified consultants are sought for housing or public housing authority related activities on an as-needed basis. Specific minimum reference counts, project types, fee zones, or formal qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided notice.
award_criteria: Future work assignments are expected to be based on expertise, experience, price, and availability. Exact weighting is not stated in the provided notice.
